features.label: Elo rating
features.description: A running team-strength rating from game results and margins; 1500 is average.

features.label: Point differential per game
features.description: Points scored minus allowed per game this season, leaning on last season early in the year.

features.label: Strength of schedule
features.description: Average Elo of the opponents faced so far this season.

features.label: Luck
features.description: Actual win rate minus expected win rate from points; teams that win more than their points say tend to come back down.

features.label: Turnover margin per game
features.description: Takeaways minus giveaways per game; partly skill, partly luck that regresses.

features.label: Offensive EPA per play
features.description: Expected points added per offensive play: how much each snap improves the scoring outlook. Around 0 is average, +0.1 is very good.

features.label: Offensive success rate
features.description: Share of offensive plays that improve the scoring outlook (EPA above zero).

features.label: Passing EPA per play
features.description: Expected points added per pass play, including sacks and scrambles.

features.label: Rushing EPA per play
features.description: Expected points added per designed run.

features.label: Sacks allowed rate
features.description: Share of dropbacks that end in a sack.

features.label: EPA allowed per play
features.description: Expected points the defense allows per play; lower is better.

features.label: Pass EPA allowed per play
features.description: Expected points allowed per opponent pass play.

features.label: Rush EPA allowed per play
features.description: Expected points allowed per opponent designed run.

features.label: Sack rate
features.description: Share of opponent dropbacks that end in a sack.

features.label: Efficiency trend
features.description: Net EPA per play over the last four games minus the season average: improving (+) or slipping (−).

features.label: Pass rate over expected
features.description: How much more often the team passes on early downs than the situation predicts.

features.label: Blitz rate
features.description: Share of opponent dropbacks with at least one blitzer (FTN, 2022+).
